summary: Source-locked jobs and artifacts are owner-scoped, durable across restart, fenced against stale success, and preserve ownerless legacy as unreadable.
invariants: Startup and periodic maintenance recover queued or stale jobs using only immutable stored owner authority.
An accepted running cancellation cannot later transition to succeeded.
Artifact publication and job success share a fenced job transaction boundary.
Ownerless legacy generation records remain unreadable and are never assigned an inferred owner.
forbidden: Inferring owners for legacy source-locked records.
Publishing success from a fenced stale runner.
Returning another owner's job or artifact.
